name: Erlebnistherme Zillertal
kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnistherme Zillertal in Fügen delivers year-round aquatic leisure and wellness, featuring giant tube water slides, heated brine outdoor pools, and extensive saunas.
preis: Admission charges apply (flexible tickets for leisure pool, sauna zone, and families)
beschreibung:
Überblick

The Erlebnistherme Zillertal in Fügen, positioned at the entrance of the renowned Zillertal Valley, stands as one of Western Austria's most comprehensive family water parks and wellness centers. Cradled beneath the alpine peaks of the Tux and Kitzbühel Alps, the resort guarantees restorative aquatic enjoyment across all four seasons, regardless of mountain weather. The core of the indoor water world features a sprawling adventure pool equipped with a raging current channel, bubble geysers, gentle surge waves, and soothing hydromassage alcoves. Thrill seekers head straight to the twin championship slides, including the 133-metre 'Black Hole' tube waterslide and high-speed enclosed chutes featuring pulsating audiovisual effects. For therapeutic unwinding, an outdoor heated saltwater brine pool maintains a blissful temperature of 34 degrees Celsius year-round. An expansive sauna village featuring eight themed saunas, herbal steam grottos, and panoramic lounges completes this premier leisure destination.

Route & Anforderungen

A visit to the spa is completely weatherproof and universally accessible thanks to thoughtful barrier-free design. All pool zones, quiet lounges, and poolside dining areas are connected via level walkways and wide elevators accommodating wheelchairs and strollers. Dedicated aquatic hoists are available to facilitate pool access for visitors with reduced mobility. Families typically plan for a three- to four-hour stay. Young children under four enjoy their own safe toddlers' paddling pool featuring mini-slides and interactive water toys. Standard swimwear, bath towels, and non-slip sandals are required; cozy bathrobes can be rented on site.

Besuch & Anreise

Motorists arrive via motorway A12 (exit Zillertal) and follow the federal highway B169 straight to Fügen. Over 300 free car parking spaces are provided right outside the thermal complex. Traveling by public transport, take Austrian Federal Railways (ÖBB) to Jenbach station, connecting directly with the Zillertalbahn scenic railway or regional buses to Fügen station, located an easy ten-minute stroll from the baths.

Tipps

After racing down the tube waterslides, relax inside the warm outdoor brine pool: floating comfortably in 34-degree saltwater with gentle underwater acoustic melodies while gazing at the snowcapped Zillertal mountains is pure bliss.
